chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Jamil, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام:
He said: “When the water touches your skin, that is sufficient for you.”

key_terms.اَلْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification being discussed
key_terms.جِلْدَكَ: your skin, indicating the body surface that water must reach
key_terms.مَسَّ: touched or came into contact with

ai.seo_question: In ritual purification, is it sufficient for water simply to reach the skin?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purification, indicating that the essential requirement is for water to reach the skin. It highlights sufficiency in the act of purification and serves as a concise juristic principle in the chapter on janabah and purification from it.
